test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The tropic of cancer does NOT pass through which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Tropic of Cancer:-**

 
 
• The Tropic of Cancer is **an imaginary line of latitude located at approximately 23.5 degrees north of the equator.**
 
• It is one of the five major lines of latitude that mark the Earth's surface and plays a significant role in defining the Earth's climate zones.
 
• The Tropic of Cancer is specifically the northernmost point where the Sun appears directly overhead at noon during the June solstice.
 
• This event marks the beginning of summer in the Northern Hemisphere. It also signifies the boundary of the tropical region and separates it from the subtropical and temperate zones.
 
• The Tropic of Cancer passes through several countries, including India, Mexico, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and China, among others.
 
• **It does not pass through Odisha.**
 
• It passes through:-
 
 
• Gujrat
 
• Rajasthan
 
• Chhattisgarh
 
• Madhya Pradesh
 
• Jharkhand
 
• West Bengal
 
• Tripura
 
• Mizoram
